title: transit pipeline creates only genesis log entries (no parent chain)
description:
## What / Why
In crates/transit/src/peering/pipeline.rs, every LogEntry is created with parent_cids: vec![] (empty), regardless of existing tips. This means the per-group Merkle-CRDT never forms a DAG from transit ingestion — each article appears as a genesis entry, so the group log degenerates into an unlinked set of roots instead of a chain.

## Trigger → Bad Behavior
Any article ingested via transit peering (IHAVE/TAKETHIS) → LogEntry stored with no parents → reconcile() between peers will send all entries as WANT every time (no shared ancestry) → O(n) reconciliation traffic for n articles instead of O(delta) → log invariant (monotonic chain per group) is violated.

## Fix
Before calling log.append(), call log.list_tips(group) and pass the result as parent_cids in the new LogEntry. This is what the reader's append_to_groups() already does correctly.
